links.outcome: Therapeutic accuracy compared across four competing LLMs on same 100 cases
links.effect: Therapeutic accuracy: Gemini 2.5 Pro 86%, DeepSeek-R1 and Claude Sonnet-4 69% each, ChatGPT-5 64% (p = 0.0001); Gemini significantly better than others.
links.quote: Overall differences in therapeutic performance among the four models were statistically significant (p = 0.0001).

links.outcome: Correctness of LLM therapeutic recommendations, showing risk of incorrect outputs if unverified
links.effect: Therapeutic accuracy was 64-86% across models, significantly lower than diagnostic accuracy (92-99%; p ≤ 0.001 for each model).
links.quote: For each model, diagnostic performance was significantly higher than therapeutic performance (p ≤ 0.001 for each comparison).

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic and therapeutic reasoning performance of four commercial LLMs on 100 retrospective otolaryngology patient cases with expert review, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
